# **1.Introduction** {#1.introduction}

This report presents the results of **quality assurance retesting** conducted on the **EEBM Nuwara Aale Concert System([https://nuwara.vercel.app/](https://nuwara.vercel.app/))**. The retesting focused on verifying previously identified defects and checking the website’s navigation, page content, interactive features, and footer functionality to ensure all components work as expected and provide a complete user experience. The defects that remain after retesting are detailed in the following section.

# **2.Objective** {#2.objective}

* To verify that all design elements work as expected.   
* To identify bugs, errors, or usability issues  
* To ensure responsiveness across devices and browsers  
* To assess overall user experience and performance

# **3.Scope of Testing** {#3.scope-of-testing}

**The testing covered the following areas:**

* UI/UX issues  
* Broken links or buttons  
* Form validation issues  
* Mobile responsiveness  
* Spelling and grammar mistakes  
* Performance/loading issues  
* Browser compatibility  
* Any functional bugs

# **4.Test Environment** {#4.test-environment}

* Browsers: Google Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge  
* Devices:  Windows laptop  
* Operating Systems: Windows 11  
* Internet Connection: Wifi and Mobile Data

# **5.Test Types Performed** {#5.test-types-performed}

* Functional Testing  
* Usability Testing  
* UI/UX Testing  
* Compatibility Testing  
* Performance Testing  
* Link Testing

# **7.Evidence / Screenshots & Recommendation** {#7.evidence-/-screenshots-&-recommendation}

**1\. Public Portal – Poster Mobile Responsive Issue (TC-05)**

On the **PC view, the bottom part of the Nuwara Aale poster is missing**. In the **mobile responsive view, half of the poster is missing**.

![][image2]

**Recommendation:** Fix the poster's responsive styling and image sizing so the **complete poster is properly displayed on both PC and mobile devices** without any cropped or missing content.

**2\. Public Portal – Footer Company Link Not Working (TC-06)**

The developer company name **“Ever Efficient Business Management (Pvt) Ltd”** is displayed at the bottom of the page, but it is **not linked**.

![][image3]

**Recommendation:** Link the company name to the **official company website**.

**3\. Admin Portal – Global Search Not Implemented (TC-08)**

The **global search** option is displayed in the Admin Portal but has **no implemented functionality**.

![][image4]

**Recommendation:** Implement the global search functionality to allow administrators to **search and find relevant information**.

**4\. Admin Portal – Mobile Responsive Issue (TC-12)**

In the mobile responsive view, **half of the Admin Portal page is missing**, preventing users from viewing the complete page content.

![][image5]

**Recommendation:** Fix the responsive layout so the **complete page content is visible and usable** on mobile devices.

**5\. Booking – Status Filters Not Implemented (TC-13)**

The **All Statuses, Pending Verification, Confirmed, Paid, Pending, and Rejected** status filters are **not functional**.

![][image6]

**Recommendation:** Implement all status filters so administrators can **filter bookings according to their status**.

**6\. Booking – Manual Booking Form Text Not Visible (TC-19)**

The **text and labels in the Manual Booking form are not visible**, making the form difficult to use.

![][image7]

**Recommendation:** Fix the text styling, color, and visibility so **all form labels and content are clearly readable**.

**7\. Booking – Page Heading Not Visible (TC-21)**

The **“Booking Management”** heading is not visible on the Booking page.

![][image8]

**Recommendation:** Fix the heading styling or text color so **“Booking Management” is clearly visible**.

**8\. Packages – Page Heading Not Visible (TC-22)**

The **“Packages”** heading is not visible on the Packages page.

![][image9]

**Recommendation:** Fix the heading styling or text color so the **“Packages” heading is clearly visible**.

**9\. Packages – Add New Package Form Text Not Visible (TC-24)**

The **text and labels in the Add New Package form are not visible**.

![][image10]

**Recommendation:** Fix the form's text styling and color so **all labels and entered information are clearly readable**.

**10\. Packages – Configure Tier Not Implemented (TC-25)**

**Evidence:** The **Configure Tier** option does not perform any action.

![][image11]

**Recommendation:** Implement the Configure Tier functionality so administrators can **configure package tiers as intended**.

**11\. Packages – Edit Option Not Implemented (TC-26)**

The **Edit** option for existing packages is **not functional**.

![][image12]

**Recommendation:** Implement the Edit functionality so administrators can **modify existing package details**.

**12\. Packages – Done Option Not Implemented (TC-27)**

The **Done** option in the package workflow is **not functional**.

![][image13]

**Recommendation:** Implement the Done option so administrators can **complete and save the intended package changes**.

# **8.Observation** {#8.observation}

1. **Sidebar Navigation:** Public Event and Admin Portal links work correctly.  
2. **Public Portal:** The countdown timer, Book Now button, and Buy Ticket form work correctly. However, in the mobile responsive view, half of the Nuwara Aale poster is missing, and the developer company name "Ever Efficient Business Management (Pvt) Ltd" at the bottom of the page is not linked.  
3. **Admin Portal –** Authentication: Login and Logout work correctly. The top navigation search option is not implemented.  
4. **Admin Portal –** Sidebar: Dashboard, Booking, Packages, View Public Event, and Logout links work correctly.  
5. **Dashboard:** View All Bookings and the Recent Bookings table's View and Verify buttons work correctly.  
6. **Bookings Page:** The All Packages filter, Sort, search, View/Verify/Delete actions, Export CSV, Manual Booking, and Per Page options work correctly. However, the booking status filters (All Statuses, Pending Verification, Confirmed, Paid, Pending, and Rejected) are not implemented, the Manual Booking form text is not visible, and the "Booking Management" heading text is not visible.  
7. **Packages Page:** Add New Package, Configure Tier, and Edit/Done options are not implemented. The Add New Package form text and the "Packages" heading text are also not visible.  
8. **Admin Portal –** Mobile Responsive View: In the mobile responsive view, half of the page is missing.  
9. **Overall UI:** The system's overall UI and text content are displayed correctly, except for the identified missing poster section and unlinked company name on the Public Portal, the missing page content in the Admin Portal mobile responsive view, and the invisible heading and form text.

# 

# 

# **9.Conclusion**  {#9.conclusion}

Out of **28 test cases** executed on the **EEBM Nuwara Aale Concert System**, **16 passed**, **7 failed**, and **6 were not implemented**, resulting in an overall **pass rate of 57.15%**, a **failure rate of 25.00%**, and a **not-implemented rate of 21.43%**. Core functionality such as the **Public Portal's countdown timer, Book Now button, and Buy Ticket form**, **Admin Portal Login and Logout**, **sidebar navigation**, **Dashboard booking actions**, and Booking page **All Packages filter, Sort, Search, View/Verify/Delete actions, Export CSV, Manual Booking, and Per Page options** worked correctly. However, several issues were identified, including the **missing part of the Nuwara Aale poster** and the **unlinked developer company name** on the Public Portal in the mobile responsive view, **missing page content in the Admin Portal mobile responsive view**, and **invisible heading and form text** on the Booking and Packages pages. Additionally, the **Admin Portal search**, **Booking status filters**, **Add New Package**, **Configure Tier**, and **Edit/Done options** are **not implemented**. Overall, the system demonstrates **good progress in its core booking and administration functionality**, but the identified **UI defects and unimplemented features require attention before final verification**.
